data.name: Wakalat
data.long_meaning: Wakalat is a unisex name of Arabic and Urdu origin. It translates to 'guardian' or 'protector'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'wakil', which means 'agent' or 'representative'. The name Wakalat signifies power and strength, as a guardian is someone who shields and safeguards those under their care.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Wakalat can be seen as a reminder of Allah's protection and care for His creation. The name can also be interpreted as a call to be a guardian of one's faith and moral values, and to protect and uplift others.

In Islamic law, Wakalah refers to the delegation of power or representation where one person acts on behalf of another. Ibn Khaldun discussed the importance of Wakalah in the context of social organization and political power, emphasizing the role of trust and consent in such relationships.
